description: Attach a normal VPC to a Transit VPC (Transit VPC Connect). If the Transit VPC belongs to another account, transitVpcLoginId and transitVpcName are required and the owner must accept via ncloud_accept_reject_transit_vpc_connect. Use dryRun=true to preview without creating.

dryRun.description: If true, returns a preview without actually creating the resource

transitVpcConnectName.description: Name (3-30 chars; lowercase letters, digits, '-'; starts with a letter). Auto-assigned if omitted

transitVpcLoginId.description: Login ID (email) of the Transit VPC owner account. Required when the Transit VPC belongs to another account

transitVpcName.description: Transit VPC name. Required when the Transit VPC belongs to another account

transitVpcNo.description: Transit VPC number (a VPC created with vpcTypeCode=TRANSIT)

name: ncloud_create_transit_vpc_connect
